about_the_game:
Tootum is a charming pixel art metroidvania game that immerses players in a magical world full of mysteries. With magic-based combat, a wide variety of items, and an engaging narrative, Tootum offers a rich experience in exploration and discovery.

You play as an anonymous emissary of the enigmatic Magical Society, sent to the continent of Vonlar, which is being overrun by mystical creatures. It’s up to you to investigate what’s happening — but the world’s deepest secrets will only be revealed to those who dare to venture deep into its hidden paths. The story is told through exploration itself, creating a naturally immersive and intriguing experience.

✨ Key Features:

Magic and Strategic Combat: Defeat monsters using spells that can be customized based on the chosen magic book. There are three books, each with unique traits that directly influence the player’s playstyle.

Intuitive Exploration: As you progress, you'll find hidden items that unlock new abilities, such as wall-jumping and agile movement, making progression dynamic and fun.

Customized Progression System: With the coins collected along the journey, you can purchase your magic book — your choice will shape your entire combat experience and progression.

Indie Passion Project: Created by a solo developer, Tootum is the result of handcrafted work made with care and dedication. This personal touch is reflected in the atmosphere, mechanics, and attention to detail.

If you're a fan of metroidvania games and enjoy experiences that blend magic, mystery, and challenge, Tootum is an excellent addition to your library. Now available on Steam — don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! The game may receive a launch week discount.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12+
  • Processor: Apple M1 ou Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU com suporte a OpenGL 2.1 (NVIDIA GeForce 6000 Series, AMD Radeon HD 2000 Series, ou equivalente).
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple M1 ou Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU com suporte a OpenGL 2.1 (NVIDIA GeForce 6000 Series, AMD Radeon HD 2000 Series, ou equivalente).
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
